title: Milwaukee DSA Ready for Statewide Governor’s Race as Madison DSA Joins in Endorsing Francesca Hong
notes: Verified on Milwaukee DSA’s official site. The February 9, 2026 announcement states that Milwaukee DSA voted to endorse Francesca Hong for governor and records the chapter-aligned electoral planks advanced with that endorsement: abolishing ICE, healthcare, paid family leave, a strong union movement, public power, and opposition to billionaire-driven data-center expansion. The official current-endorsements page independently identifies this as Milwaukee DSA’s 2026 endorsement. Official site search, endorsement archives, and Wayback CDX discovery were checked; no public 2026 candidate questionnaire or archived snapshot was found, so this adopted endorsement statement is the best official cycle-specific platform/planks source.
